sections.bio:
I was TERRIFIED of social media.

When I quit my corporate job (without a back-up plan 😳), it took me months - and a program - before I dared to post my very first piece of content… a simple quote on Instagram.

My business coach at the time said, "You have to go live every day!" I couldn't even post a quote. 
Going live? 
Not happening.

Then I gave LinkedIn a real shot. 
I invested in a program that felt way too transactional… so I did the opposite.

I showed up. 
I connected with people. 
I actually had FUN.
And everything changed.

☑ Aligned opportunities 
☑ Thoughtful conversations 
☑ Dream clients reaching out

No chasing. 
No dancing for views. 
No cold pitching in DMs.

I'm a former UBS & Big4 exec, turned LinkedIn & Business Growth Strategist.

Today I help established coaches and service providers build a business that doesn't run on their hours.

And it comes down to two things: 
1/ An audience that trusts you, and
2/ An offer you can scale.

LinkedIn is how I'll help you build the first. 
A scalable program is how we build the second.

And if I can learn to show up and sell online - you can too.

Here's where we focus: 
→ Building an audience that actually buys (no bro tactics, no DMs) 
→ Attracting qualified leads who reach out to you 
→ Creating a scalable program that frees you from trading time for money

And no - you don't need thousands of followers. 
You start where you are.

★ Recent Client Wins ★
• Maryna enrolled 3 clients in 8 weeks
• Sara generated 85 leads + 5 clients in weeks
• Lisa generated 26 leads + 7 clients in 3 weeks
• Marlies enrolled 11 clients into her first program
• Jeanette made $11K from her first online program
• Araceli built to 700 leads + ran her program 10 times

This was never about going viral, or getting famous.

↳ It's about becoming the authority in your niche by sharing content that genuinely helps - and turning that trust into a business that gives you more time, income, and freedom.

Check out the resources in my Featured section, or go to my YouTube channel: https://www.youtube.com/@josefinewanner

📩 Or send me a connection request, and let's talk

posts.text:
I told her we only have 60 minutes, and that I have a hard stop.  

She started babbling. Telling me how amazing my offer is. How it's exactly what she's needing. 

Almost selling my own offer back to me.  

I admit. I stopped listening. My thoughts went to the $$$.   

Would she want to pay in full.  
Maybe she wanted to split the payment.  
Can't wait to onboard her, and share the celebration post.  

57 minutes of babbling. Time to wrap it up. Need to dial in to my next meeting.  

"So... I'll join in a year."  

"Say what?!"  

"Yes. I'll join your program in a year."  


I honestly can't even remember what I responded. But let me tell you this. I was very confused.


Turns out, knowing your objections isn't the same as knowing how to handle them in the room.  

And I wish I'd had access to Synthesia Roleplay Sessions back then.  
(Quick disclosure: this is a paid collab with them.)   

A real, back-and-forth practice conversation with an AI Avatar that can throw a curveball like "I'll join in a year" at you, coached in the moment, as many times as you need, before the real call.  

I'll add the link to their Roleplay Sessions landing page in the comment section - so you can check it out!   


P.S. Ever gotten the "I need to think about it..." or "I need to talk to my spouse..." objection?  
I have. More times than I'd like to admit. 
What's the objection that still catches you off guard?

Posting from a LinkedIn business page won’t grow your business. 

And the reason is that very few people will see those posts. 

Yet creating a business page is still important for credibility and trust. 


Read my completely new Blog article now, to learn how to set it up correctly. 

Here's the link to read it now: https://lnkd.in/eSFQAWGy 

Coming up next on the Blog - Should You Join Substack?

You don't need thousands of followers to go viral.
And you definitely don't need thousands of followers to make sales on LinkedIn.

I sometimes hear people say you need at least:
1,500 followers.
3,000 followers.
5,000 followers.
10,000 followers.
…before LinkedIn can really work for your business.

Well.
That's bollocks.

Anette Jernström - who just had a post hit 119,000+ views (and still growing) - was my very first LinkedIn client.

She has never focused on going viral.

Instead, she's focused on building a LinkedIn strategy that actually works for her.

For her business.
For her audience.
And for her very busy lifestyle.

Because Anette is a multi-passionate entrepreneur who travels A LOT.

She doesn't spend her entire life creating content.
She doesn't chase the algorithm.

And yet… Here we are. 119k+ views. 🚀
Go check out her post here: https://lnkd.in/p/eZyZhH_m


And if you're wondering why this particular post took off, I recently shared the 5 traits I see again and again in viral LinkedIn posts in my latest YouTube video.

Because while going viral is never the goal - it's a pretty nice cherry on top of a LinkedIn strategy that's already doing its job.


P.S. Anette's post is about entrepreneurship, and how the work we do can change the life of others. 

It's personal, and inspiring at the same time. 
Those are 2 of the traits. 
To get the other 3 traits of a viral post - go check out my YouTube video here https://lnkd.in/eyZdYCXH

Holy macaroni - my very first IN-PERSON EVENT is taking shape! 🎉

And I get to share the stage with the fabulous Janene Liston - The Pricing Lady.

So... what are we creating?

At a high level, we want to give you something that most business owners don't give themselves nearly enough of:

A few hours OFF from running your business - to actually work ON your business.


Because I guess we've both been to enough webinars, workshops, conferences, and events where you leave completely fired up.

Your notebook is full.
Your head is full.
You have 37 brilliant ideas about everything you're going to change.

And then...

Client work happens.
Emails happen.
Life happens.

And slowly but surely, that fire dies.

Not this time!

On November 13th, we're getting 20 business owners into a room in Zurich for three hours.

And you bring ONE offer.

Then we're going to work on three things:

→ POSITION
Because you can have the best offer in the world, but if the right people don't see it, understand it and know why they need it - it's going to be pretty hard to sell.

→ PRICE
Because pricing isn't about "charging what you're worth."
It's about making a smart commercial decision about what you're charging, why you're charging it - and whether that price actually works for you, your customers, AND your business.

→ PROFIT
This is where we make sure that lovely notebook doesn't disappear into a drawer when you get home.

You'll turn what you've worked on during the morning into a concrete 90-day action plan.

Could those 90 days generate more revenue than the previous six months?
Maybe.
That's the goal.

But hey - we're not doing the work for you.

You still have to do that bit yourself.

What we WILL do is spend those three hours guiding you, challenging you, teaching you, listening to you, cheering you on and helping you make the decisions that set you up to actually do it.

Leave with clearer positioning, a smarter pricing decision, and a concrete 90-day plan to generate more sales and profit.

📍 Zurich, Switzerland
📅 Friday, November 13th
🎟️ CHF 100
👥 Maximum 20 service providers / coaches / consultants

If you're in or around Zurich on November 13th - it's time to get your ticket.

You'll find all the details - and the link to secure your spot, here, https://lnkd.in/e6gyDF46 and in the event below.

This is how LinkedIn works.
I quit my job at UBS in 2019 and started my own thing.

Marta Zielińska, my friend and former team member at the bank, supported me from the very beginning.

She connected me with Araceli Canedo Bebbington when she was at a cross roads in her career. 

Araceli joined the very first cohort of LinkedIn Breakthrough - before either of us really knew whether the program would work. 

It did. Really well. For both of us. 

Yesterday, Araceli hosted one of her amazing networking events, this time we also got to celebrate the launch of her very first book.

Natalya Tarasova (not in any picture this time) sent me a connection request in 2021. She had just moved to Zurich, and we met up for a coffee. 

Later, she sent the lovely Dorothée L. Troyanov my way, who later joined my program too.

And because both Araceli and Dorothee had been in my program, they connected.

Katia Vlachos, Ph.D. and I connected here in 2023, and later met for coffee. She's one of those fierce women you just want to have in your corner. 

Yesterday, Dorothee and Katia finally met IRL for the first time.

And Dorothee brought her friend Stefan Biasini to Araceli’s book launch. So, now, I'm connected to Stefan too. Turns out - we have a similar corporate background. 


You might say: "Yeah, but you all meet IRL now. I see your selfies. Duh."
Exactly. 
But LinkedIn is where many of us initially met.


It’s where we stay connected.
It’s how we stay on top of each other’s minds.
And it’s how one connection leads to another, which leads to another, which leads to another...


You don’t have to have LinkedIn all figured out.
Heck, you don’t even need to post here.

But connect with your colleagues. 
Your former colleagues. 
Old friends. 
New friends. 
People you meet at events. 
People you find interesting.

And then stay connected.
Send them a DM.
Meet them for coffee.
Take a selfie. (Or don’t.)
Celebrate their wins.

Introduce good people to other good people. And stay curious about where one simple connection might lead.

Because you really never know. 
And THAT is how LinkedIn works.


P.S. the people I tagged here are all amazing, and open to new, cool connections. So if you're not yet connected - send them a connection request, and a DM. Tell them I sent my regards.
